title: Run-Length String Compression
description: Given a non-empty string `s`, compress consecutive runs of identical characters: for each maximal group of repeating characters, write the character followed by the decimal count if the group length is 2 or more, or just the character alone if the group length is 1. Return the compressed string.
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters.
hints: Use two pointers: advance j while s[j] == s[i] to measure each run's length.
Append s[i], and append str(runLength) only when runLength > 1.

examples.explanation: Runs are 'a' x2, 'b' x2, and 'c' x3, yielding "a2b2c3".
A single character has run length 1, so no count is appended.
